profile_text: Mergers and acquisitions advisory services are the specialty of this German firm, which has experienced a 76.9% growth since its baseline, driven by its focus on medium-sized companies. With a team of 23 employees as of 2024, the company's expertise in corporate finance has enabled it to establish a strong presence in the market. As a scaler, it continues to expand its operations, providing critical support to medium-sized businesses navigating complex financial transactions.
